Package edu.towson.cosc442.halls7800.entity

Class Npc

java.lang.Object
edu.towson.cosc442.halls7800.engine.Actor
edu.towson.cosc442.halls7800.entity.Creature
edu.towson.cosc442.halls7800.entity.Npc
public class Npc extends Creature
A friendly character or fixture the player can talk to by walking into it. NPCs never move, cannot be attacked, and are not scheduled. What they say and do is in quest.Conversations.

The Halls' residents are fictional characters. Their names are an affectionate nod to the Towson University Computer & Information Sciences faculty; their roles and dialogue are invented for the game and say nothing about the real people.
